title: Ogyges
summary: Raleigh names Ogyges in the History of the World (1617) and says he was born 67 yeeres after Jacob.
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). He says Ogyges was born 67 yeeres after Jacob. That figure is not a yeere of the World. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

birth.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book I, Part I, Chapter VII, §. II, sig. 94b
birth.note: Body intake. “him” is Jacob, named in the same sentence. Not a yeere of the World. Not placed on flood-of-ogyges. See N6.

free_source_links.locator: Contents, Book I, Part I, Chapter VII, sig. 25a
